landing.heroSubtitle: A production-ready dictionary management tool featuring transitive relationships, live sentence parsing, and an isolated guest-session web graph.
landing.transitiveDesc: If A is a synonym to B, and B to C, lookup immediately resolves and links A and C together.
landing.sentenceAnalyzerDesc: Type complete sentences and watch synonyms appear instantly above each recognized word as you write.
landing.relationshipGraphDesc: Browse a visual, force-directed network showing word clusters color-coded by semantic groups.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.addSynonymPairDesc: Define a new bi-directional connection between two words.
dashboard.errorSelfSynonym: A word cannot be a synonym of itself.
dashboard.lookupDesc: Search for a word to resolve all its linked synonyms transitively.
dashboard.seedingDesc: Import a massive dataset of <1>1,000+ words</1> from the Datamuse API to simulate a heavy, real-world synonym relational web.
dashboard.seedingSuccess: Successfully seeded! Loaded {{count}} unique words and relations.
dashboard.deleteInfoSingleDesc: All connections between this word and its synonyms will be severed, but those synonyms and their other connections will remain in the database.
dashboard.deleteInfoCascadeTitle: The following words and all their connections will be deleted:
dashboard.deleteInfoCascadeWarning: A total of <1>{{count}}</1> words will be deleted. This action is irreversible!

analyzer.title: Live Sentence Analyzer
analyzer.desc: Type a sentence. Synonym overlays will appear dynamically above matching words as you type.
analyzer.placeholder: Type a sentence here... (e.g. The runner was quick and happy)

presets.preset1: The quick and rapid runner felt happy and cheerful.
presets.preset2: Please wash and clean the dirty dishes to purify them.
presets.preset3: An intelligent and clever student solved the fast puzzle.
presets.preset4: A joyful child loves a clean and tidy room.
presets.preset5: The rapid response was smart and quick.

graph.legendTip1: 💡 Drag nodes to interact with physics.
graph.legendTip2: 💡 Scroll to Zoom. Drag canvas to Pan.
graph.legendTip3: 💡 Select a node to highlight its transitive synonym network.
